prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic multi-scene fashion collection with cinematic lighting and modern Hollywood editorial polish, using original adult subjects in four distinct lifestyle-fashion scenarios.
prompt.main_subject: Use two original adult women consistently across the collection. Subject 1 appears in a luxury boat scene with blonde messy beach waves and chunky black sunglasses. Subject 2 appears in three scenes with an original adult identity and styling appropriate to each scenario. Do not reproduce Sydney Sweeney, Ana de Armas or any other public figure.
prompt.composition_elements: Scene 1: Subject 1 leans back on a luxury boat on a lake with pine forest background, one arm raised, blowing a kiss or laughing behind her hand, wearing black-and-white zip-up wetsuit or athletic swimwear. Scene 2: Subject 2 sits elegantly on a black leather tufted sofa in a high-fashion lounge with neon pink and blue lights, wearing a red sequined blazer and skirt over black silk with layered gold necklaces and bangles. Scene 3: Subject 2 sits cross-legged on a wicker sofa in a lush tropical garden holding a drink, wearing a yellow-and-blue patterned strapless summer dress with bright pink heels, green champagne bucket and leaf-patterned pillow nearby. Scene 4: Subject 2 takes a selfie with a fan under an umbrella on a rainy red-carpet street, wearing a white long-sleeve button-up blouse with a stylish updo. Keep each scenario visually distinct but editorially coherent.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Use cinematic lighting appropriate to each scene: natural lake daylight, neon pink-blue lounge light, warm tropical garden daylight and soft rainy street reflections. Maintain realistic water, sequins, leather, silk, foliage, umbrella and wet pavement textures with polished luxury editorial atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic high-resolution collection, 8K-style detail, 1080x1080 or 1080x2400 social-media layouts, coherent color grading, realistic fabric, skin, jewelry, foliage, water and rain textures, no text, logos or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic cinematic fashion collection featuring two original adult women across four scenes. Scene 1: original blonde adult with messy beach waves and chunky black sunglasses leaning back on a luxury lake boat, arm raised, blowing a kiss or laughing behind her hand, black-and-white zip-up wetsuit or athletic swimwear, pine forest background. Scene 2: second original adult woman seated on black tufted leather sofa in neon pink-blue lounge, red sequined blazer and skirt, black silk inner, layered gold necklaces and bangles. Scene 3: same second woman cross-legged on wicker sofa in lush tropical garden holding a drink, yellow-blue patterned strapless summer dress, bright pink heels, green champagne bucket and leaf pillow. Scene 4: same woman taking a selfie with a fan under umbrella on rainy red-carpet street, white long-sleeve blouse, elegant updo. High-resolution 8K-style photorealism, cinematic luxury editorial lighting, no public-figure likeness.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, fetish styling, minor, teenage appearance, public-figure likeness, Sydney Sweeney likeness, Ana de Armas likeness, inconsistent identity, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed hands, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, random text, logo, watermark
